events.title: Holiday Garden Railway: Nighttime Express
events.organizer: Morris Arboretum & Gardens of the University of Pennsylvania
events.ageLabel: All ages, free for kids 2 and under
events.schedule: Select Thu to Sun nights, Nov 28 to Dec 20, 4:30pm to 8pm
events.priceLabel: $22 adults, $12 ages 3 to 17, free 2 and under, members less

registration.note: General tickets go on sale Nov 9. Members can buy now. Tickets are timed, so pick an arrival time and get there within 15 minutes of it to avoid a parking wait.

events.description: The garden railway after dark. Model trains run past laser lights in the trees and sparkling lights along the track. Trains stop in heavy rain, snow or ice.
events.sourceNote: Nights (Sat Nov 28, Dec 5, 12, 19; Sun Nov 29, Dec 6, 13, 20; Thu Dec 10, 17; Fri Dec 11, 18), 4:30-8:00 PM, prices (adult $22 / member $17, youth 3-17 $12 / member $10, 0-2 free), advance timed tickets and 'General Tickets Available November 9' (no time given) confirmed on morrisarboretum.org HGR Nighttime Express and Holiday Garden Railway pages and the homepage. The event header says Dec 10-20, but Nov 28-29 nights are also listed. Supporter+ member-only nights Dec 3-4 are left out.

events.title: Holiday Garden Railway
events.organizer: Morris Arboretum & Gardens of the University of Pennsylvania
events.ageLabel: All ages, free for kids 2 and under
events.schedule: Daily Nov 21 to Dec 30, 10am to 4pm (closed Dec 24 and 25)
events.priceLabel: $22 adults, $12 ages 3 to 17, free 2 and under

registration.note: Daytime viewing is included with garden admission and needs no separate ticket. Buying admission online saves $2 per ticket.

events.description: A third of a mile of model train track with loops and tunnels, set among plants and twinkling lights. The path is stroller accessible but narrow, with a downhill slope.
events.sourceNote: Daily 10 AM-4 PM viewing included with general admission ($22 adults, $20 seniors, $12 youth 3-17, 2 and under free, $2 online savings), closures Dec 24, 25, 31 and Jan 1, stroller note and track description confirmed on morrisarboretum.org Holiday Garden Railway page and homepage. Opening date conflict on the organizer site: the homepage and page header say Nov 21, the FAQ says Nov 22. Sessions follow Nov 21 and cover the first 12 days. Thanksgiving hours are not stated separately.

events.sourceNote: Season Nov 19, 2026 to Jan 9, 2027, select nights 5-9 PM, closed Dec 24, 25 and Jan 1, open Dec 31, advance online reservations required, prices (general $27-31, anytime $29-34, members 10-20% off, parking $22) and highlights confirmed on philadelphiazoo.org/luminature. The nightly calendar lives on the ticketing site, which was not reachable, so sessions list only opening night and Dec 31. Child and under-2 pricing are not stated. The LumiNature FAQ page still shows 2025-26 dates.
